reference.code: fn nums(s:&str)->Option<Vec<i32>>{if s.is_empty(){return None}let mut o=vec![];for z in s.split(','){let x:i32=z.parse().ok()?;if x.to_string()!=z||x< -1000||x>1000{return None}o.push(x)}Some(o)}fn join(a:&[i32])->String{a.iter().map(|x|x.to_string()).collect::<Vec<_>>().join(",")}pub fn zero_segment_sums(s:&str)->Option<String>{let a=nums(s)?;let(mut o,mut n,mut seen)=(vec![],0,false);for x in a.into_iter().chain(std::iter::once(0)){if x==0{if seen{o.push(n)}n=0;seen=false}else{n+=x;seen=true}}Some(join(&o))}
